select b.id, b.user_name as userName, b.real_name as realName, b.phone as phone, b.email as email, b.sex as sex, b.status as status, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct br.name separator ',') as roleNames, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct br.id separator ',') as roleIds from base_user b left join base_user_role r on b.id = r.user_id left join base_role br on r.role_id = br.id where b.del_flag = 0 and r.del_flag = 0 and br.del_flag = 0
AND b.real_name LIKE CONCAT ('%', #{realName}, '%')
group by b.id order by b.id

select zu.id, zu.del_flag, zu.gmt_create, zu.gmt_create_user, zu.gmt_modified, zu.gmt_modified_user, zu.user_name, zu.org_id, zu.password, zu.real_name, zu.auth_type, zu.avatar, zu.phone, zu.email, zu.sex, zu.status, zu.dept_id, h.DEPARTMENTNAME as dept_name from zzccaidp_user zu left join hrmdepartment h on zu.dept_id =h.ID where zu.user_name = #{userName}
